title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: Companion
description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

title: Aniara
description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

title: Dim Sum Funeral
description: The grown children of an overbearing Chinese matriarch reluctantly gather to take part in seven days' worth of traditional funeral rites.

title: Women Is Losers
description: Celina Guerrero attempts to rise above poverty in the 1960s San Francisco.

title: The Blair Witch Project
description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch.

title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping.

title: Blair Witch
description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland.

title: The Apparition
description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run.

title: The Possession
description: Parents (Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Kyra Sedgwick) must work together to save their young daughter (Natasha Calis) from a dybbuk, a malevolent spirit that inhabits and ultimately devours its human host.

title: The Judge
description: A slick Chicago lawyer (Robert Downey Jr.) returns home to Indiana upon the passing of his mother, then soon becomes engaged in defending his estranged father (Robert Duvall), a recovering alcoholic who will be tried for a hit-and-run death.

title: The Meg
description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

title: Open Water
description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society.

title: Full Metal Jacket
description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive.

title: Carrie
description: A social misfit (Sissy Spacek) with psychic powers wreaks havoc at her prom to get even with pranksters.

title: The Craft
description: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles.

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: The East
description: Hired to infiltrate a group of ecoterrorists, an undercover operative (Brit Marling) instead finds herself growing sympathetic to the cause and attracted to the leader (Alexander Skarsgård).

title: Green Zone
description: An Army officer and his team of inspectors stumble upon an elaborate cover-up as they hunt for weapons of mass destruction in Iraq.

title: Man Down
description: With help from his best friend (Jai Courtney), a Marine (Shia LaBeouf) embarks on a desperate search to find his wife (Kate Mara) and son (Charlie Shotwell) in post-apocalyptic America.

title: Extraction
description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

title: Men
description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

title: The Last Samurai
description: In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

title: Meg 2: The Trench
description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

title: Sucker Punch
description: Retreating into a fantasy world, a captive young woman (Emily Browning) finds four allies to join in a fight to escape from the terrible fate that awaits them.

title: Cleaner
description: Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

title: Super Troopers 2
description: Former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption in Canada. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties and a smuggling ring.

title: Green Zone
description: An Army officer and his team of inspectors stumble upon an elaborate cover-up as they hunt for weapons of mass destruction in Iraq.

title: Our Kind of Traitor
description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman join forces with their American counterparts to battle a ruthless and common enemy.

title: Blood Father
description: An ex-convict (Mel Gibson) and his estranged daughter (Erin Moriarty) go on the run from her drug-dealing boyfriend (Diego Luna) and his vicious cartel.

title: Red Sparrow
description: Dominika Egorova learns to use her mind and body as a weapon after joining a secret intelligence service. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

title: Bad Santa
description: Two criminals (Billy Bob Thornton, Tony Cox) disguise themselves as St. Nick and an elf to rob stores at Christmastime.

title: Bad Santa 2
description: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve.

title: Pitch Perfect 3
description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

title: Love, Simon
description: Teenager Simon Spier hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

title: Catfish
description: An unexpected odyssey rolls out when a filmmaker's brother begins receiving unusually advanced paintings from a girl, supposedly 8 years old.

title: Megan Leavey
description: Young Marine Cpl. Megan Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive combat dog that she trains. Together, they complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

title: Monster-in-Law
description: A woman fights back when her fiancé's shrewish mother tries to destroy their relationship.

title: Walk the Line
description: Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) forms an enduring bond with June Carter (Reese Witherspoon) and struggles with drug addiction on the way to music stardom.

title: The Town
description: A Boston bank robber (Ben Affleck) looks for a way out of his criminal lifestyle after beginning a passionate romance with the woman (Rebecca Hall) that his gang briefly took hostage.

title: Grudge Match
description: A boxing promoter (Kevin Hart) offers two rival boxers (Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone) the chance to come out of retirement for one final bout.

title: Just Friends
description: A music executive (Ryan Reynolds) tries to woo his high-school crush (Amy Smart) while keeping his suspicious ex-girlfriend (Anna Faris) at bay.

title: Patti Cake$
description: Patricia, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back.

title: The Greatest Showman
description: P.T. Barnum indulges his limitless imagination to create the Barnum & Bailey circus in the 1800s. Featuring musical numbers, exotic performers and daring feats, the mesmerizing spectacle takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

title: My Soul to Take
description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier.
